elf-kit.title: Christmas Elf Kit Printable, 24 Easy Elf Ideas, Elf Arrival Letter, Elf Notes, Elf Props, Nice List Certificate, Instant Download
elf-kit.desc:
Everything you need for 24 magical elf mornings, in one printable kit. Each idea takes under 5 minutes and uses things you already have at home, and every idea has a matching note from your elf. Just set it up and leave the note.

WHAT'S INSIDE (28 pages)
- 24-day elf planner with tick boxes
- 24 easy elf ideas: what you need and how to set it up
- 24 notes from your elf, ready to cut out
- 3 arrival letters: first-time elf, returning elf, late elf
- Elf rules card
- 4 oops letters: I couldn't move, someone touched me, I'm away for a night, sorry for the mess

- Elf Cinema tickets and a North Pole travel pass
- The North Pole Times mini newspaper
